reference.primary: historical binary target-label runs after conf>0 & el_pupil>0, sorted actual timestamps, end minus start
reference.gap_sensitivity: split target runs at any ineligible edge in frozen 75-ms blocked_edges ledger (invalid/manual blink/cap); no native detector events resegmented
reference.rate_policy: same Original manual-sampled reference events at both rates; no reference resampling/cropping
reference.unknown_labels: Preserve literal original R NA/cumsum propagation in historical reference; gap-aware sensitivity treats unknown labels as explicit non-target run boundaries without propagation

duration.primary: saved native duration: classical end-start; CNN last-first+median_step
duration.sensitivity: first-to-last sample span for all events

configurations: exact Phase 2B eight classical fixed choices; primary I-HMM seed_id 0; CNN Raw primary and four fixed sensitivity branches

transport.ground_metric: Euclidean, verified with 3/4 diagonal-shift fixture giving 5
transport.historical: original compute_wasserstein_full; paired method-specific complete cases, reference sample SD scaling, zero SD=>1, n<3=>NA
transport.main: common complete trials across four classical plus CNN Raw, both rates, separate event/reference definition; same reference centring/scaling for all
transport.cnn_sensitivity: intersect primary-common set with that branch complete cases at both rates; reference scaling on explicitly recorded branch-specific subset
transport.method_sensitivity: method-specific paired complete cases retained as historical compatibility
transport.count_only: common successful-call trials across primary five families and both rates; include zero events; reference need not have 2 events
transport.outputs: raw standardized transport distance and 1/(1+d) similarity, also native-unit univariate distances
transport.solver_check: independent scipy linear_sum_assignment/n for equal-size uniform empirical measures; sorted differences for univariate W1

velocity.harmonised: raw observed coordinates at current representation; successive pairs wholly inside native event; arithmetic mean and maximum speed in deg/s
velocity.reference: same native reference boundaries, sampled only at each representation actual observed timestamps; no new interpolation
velocity.blocked: underlying Original blocked-edge component change forbids derivative; if any required edge/stencil is blocked, event velocity NA with reason
velocity.historical: exact archived whole-trial get_xy preprocessing and detector derivative; IVT/IDT previous-current, IHMM difference of degree-scaled positions, EK03 four neighbours/(1.5*(t[i+2]-t[i-2])); inclusive native endpoints
velocity.smoothing_support: historical derivative marked unavailable if its smoothing/derivative dependency stencil crosses blocked edge; preserve algorithm boundary/NA omission on supported samples
velocity.undefined: no within-event pair, missing/nonfinite positions, blocked derivative support or no finite historical speed=>explicit NA reason; no partial gap-bridged estimate
velocity.limitations: 30-Hz peak is resolution-specific observed-frame speed; no physiological/subframe peak recovery; common calibration is historical project convention, not new participant calibration

summaries.failed: all event summary measures NA, status preserved
summaries.distribution: separate pooled-event mean/sample SD and unweighted across-trial N/Mean/SD summaries; finite denominators explicit

figures.duration_velocity_axes: KDE of log10(1+duration_ms) or log10(1+speed_deg_s), all finite nonnegative observations retained; transformed density labelled
figures.duration_support: primary common-complete trials; CNN sensitivities use same exposure set with zero-event absence disclosed
figures.velocity_support: common primary availability trials; finite-event densities with missingness retained

statistical_scope: descriptive event-distribution comparisons, no population hypothesis tests or new selection
pre_result_amendment: 302 valid-row NA labels discovered during input validation before any native/reference event table, summary, velocity or transport result was calculated. Initial protocol retained in config/part3/history.
native_input_geometry: Classical Original/reference use conf/pupil-valid rows; corrected CNN Original uses full native trial sequence, as frozen C3-B. Derive a separate full-native raw-coordinate map and validate every native source-anchor/sample-count identity. Do not crop events. Invalid-support derivatives are unavailable.
